summary_ja: ファンドへの出資について、ルックスルーができる場合・できない場合・ネット・ショート・ポジションの場合の所要自己資本の算出方法を定める。
summary_en: Sets how the market risk equivalent amount or required capital is calculated for investments in funds, depending on whether look-through is possible and whether the position is net long or net short.
paragraphs: Investments in funds for which look-through to the constituents is possible (excluding the following) shall have their market risk equivalent amount calculated using the look-through approach. (i) Funds satisfying all of the requirements in the items of paragraph (4) of the preceding Article. (ii) Funds tracking an index benchmark (limited to those satisfying all of the following requirements). (a) The absolute value of the tracking difference of the fund, excluding fees and commissions (meaning the difference between the annualized returns over the most recent twelve months of the fund and of the index benchmark it tracks), is less than 1 percentage point. (b) The tracking difference of the fund referred to in (a) is verified at least once a year.

For investments in funds for which look-through to the constituents is not possible but for which information on daily market prices and investment mandates can be obtained, the market risk equivalent amount may be calculated by using any of the following methods. In this case, the method in item (i) may be used only where the fund falls under item (ii) of the preceding paragraph. (i) A method of regarding the fund as holding the index that it tracks and classifying the sensitivities of the fund into buckets under paragraph (5), item (ii) of the preceding Article. (ii) A method of, upon prior notification to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency, regarding the constituent instruments of the fund as a hypothetical portfolio of progressive investments (meaning a portfolio that assumes investment up to the maximum permitted under the investment mandate of the fund (meaning the state in which the market risk equivalent amount under the sensitivities-based method is greatest), and then assumes progressive investment in assets that lower the market risk equivalent amount). In this case, the market risk equivalent amount of the hypothetical portfolio shall be calculated on a stand-alone basis, and by the method prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following categories of risk equivalent amount. (a) Credit risk-weighted assets amount for derivative transactions: where the internal ratings-based approach is not adopted, the method prescribed in Article 43-4, paragraph (7); where the internal ratings-based approach is adopted, the method prescribed in Article 144, paragraph (8). (b) CVA risk equivalent amount: a method of multiplying the amount obtained by multiplying the credit risk-weighted assets amount for derivative transactions with the counterparty by 12% by the risk weight prescribed in Article 14 through Article 43-3-2. (iii) A method of calculating the market risk equivalent amount as an exposure to unrated equities classified into bucket number 11 in the table in Article 264, paragraph (2).

Where an equity investment in a fund does not fall under the investments listed in Article 11-3, paragraph (3), item (ii), the required capital for the investment in that fund shall be calculated by the method prescribed in each of the following items according to the following categories of position. (i) Net long position: where the internal ratings-based approach is not adopted, the method prescribed in Article 43-4, paragraph (7); where the internal ratings-based approach is adopted, the method prescribed in Article 144, paragraph (8). (ii) Net short position: a method of deducting from the amount of capital the amount obtained by multiplying that net position by 100%, in lieu of calculating the market risk equivalent amount.
